instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Send a text message, to one number or a list, through my Twilio account", and give it from; account_sid.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:send-a-text-with-twilio and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give recipients (phone numbers with country code; to for one), from (a number on the Twilio account), account_sid (the account's id) and text (or subject when there is no text).
